statement._text: I just saw Gabriella. What happened down here?
Take a look downstairs. We have a new friend.
We managed to save the Memories. Well, Roland did. He... didn't make it
I'm afraid I don't understand. Where is Roland? What happened here?
He's turned into a Lich. And not a hostile one either. His spirit has merged with the Ancestral Memories. You should probably ask him...Well, “them” for the details.
I...Is this true? Roland, a Lich? And he has become part of the Ancestral Memories? This...This is a huge change. One that I pray is for the best.
If this Lich really is willing to help us, then we may just have levelled the playing field against the Scarlet Lady... I should hurry down and speak with them.
I am glad I confided this mission to you. Your actions made a great difference today, although no one in the Collective will ever truly know what you did for them.
If the Krypteia ever needs me again, you know how to find me.
And that's all. I am done with this Krypteia work. You can handle any more of this shady business on your own.
I do indeed. Thank you for choosing to remain with us, [PlayerName]. Your continued aid is welcome.
I am proud to count you as family, [PlayerName] Aberdeen. Thank you for all you’ve done for us.
I'm disappointed, but I understand. As long as you keep what you witnessed here a secret, you're free to go. If ever you wish to help us again, come to me.
I’m glad to hear of his success, and I mourn his loss. May he rest in the arms of his ancestors, for he has done them proud today.
I just saw Gabriella. What happened down here? An army of ghosts just ran screaming through Berg and out into the wild! What did you do?!
A follower of the Scarlet Lady forced her spirit into the Ancestral Memories. Roland managed to cut her out of them. It was a disaster...

I was afraid it was something like that. Those ghosts must be corrupted memories that were severed from the group. Well, I suppose it can't be helped. If the Memories had been completely corrupted by the Scarlet Lady... The consequences would have been impossible to recover from.
You're free to do as you please, [PlayerName]. I trust your instincts. Do whatever you feel you need to do.

If you haven't already unlocked the power of Mana within you, now is an excellent opportunity. If you choose to remain a Member of the Krypteia, gaining the power of magic will make communing with the Ancestral Memories much easier.
There you are. I was hoping you’d return soon.
You've been a great help to us, [PlayerName]. I had a feeling I'd make this offer eventually, but it happened much sooner than I anticipated.
I'm going to come right out with it. I need you to join the Krypteia.
The... what?
Wait, the Krypteia actually exist?
Wait...You’re the leader of the Krypteia? That explains a lot.
You have not heard of us? Good. Then we've been doing our job. We aren't supposed to be common knowledge.

I'm sure that even if you've heard of us, you'll have misconceptions about who we are and what we do. When the Collective was first formed, some of us wanted to ensure that detailed records were kept of everything we did. More than simple paper could cover.

Thus, we enshrined the memories of several of our members into an altar, creating the Ancestral Memories. We've been adding to it ever since. This collection of memories is the heart and soul of the Collective.
It’s how we have governed and guided our people for centuries, using the advice and guidance of our ancestors. Without it, any number of calamities or dilemmas could have been the end for us.

Then, one of our members betrayed us. She used forbidden magic to devour the memories of her own ancestors. She became a Lich, and used her own bloodline as the Phylactery that maintains her immortality. You may know of her as the Scarlet Lady.
The Lich that supposedly fled to the Scarlet Moon? Everyone’s heard of that fairy tale.

I assure you, she is no fairy tale. If the Scarlet Lady were to somehow gain control over the Ancestral Memories, it would be the end of the Collective. She could use them to guide our decisions as she pleased, or unleash a horde of undead on Enmerkar, or worse.

We oppose the Scarlet lady’s efforts to control the Collective. As long as her bloodline exists, she remains immortal and dangerous to all Aurai. We consult the Ancestral Memories regularly find her potential descendants and deal with them.
You mean that you kill them.
And you want me to join... Why exactly?

Yes. It’s tragic, but it’s the only way to sever the Scarlet Lady's hold on the world. And these people are never truly innocent. All those who bear the Lady's blood hear her voice. And she has grown very effective at breaking her pawns to her will. Most times, we are merely putting a tormented creature out of their misery.
It's been ages and you haven't wiped out all of her descendants yet?
And you want me to join... Why exactly?

She has grown craftier at spawning and hiding new descendants over the ages. She isn't an opponent who leaves anything up to chance. More than once, not respecting her intelligence has caused great harm to the Collective.
And you want me to join... Why exactly?

The Memories warned me that the Scarlet Lady is moving against us. But most of our members are tied up with the war and I cannot reach out to them for help. All I have are Gabriella and Julius right now. I need new members.
Members, you say? Sounds like you have more than just me in mind.
Yes. I've already asked Roland. He has agreed. As long as he remains with the Krypteia, I will make his Blood Price payments for him. He could not refuse.
No I don't see how he could. He lacks any way to pay the Blood Price on his own.
Roland? That's a mistake.
I know how to use my assets, [PlayerName]. Roland feels he has nothing to lose. I would be a fool not to leverage that.
I know this is sudden, and that you might have doubts. I won't force you to remain with us afterwards, as long as you keep our secrets. But I desperately need help. The Collective depends on us.
Fine, I'll help, but only until this crisis is dealt with. I'm not committing to more until that's done.
You had me at secret organizations and protecting Aurai from an evil Lich. Count me in.
I'm not interested.
Very well. If you're not willing to remain with the Krypteia once this threat has passed, I understand.

I’ve already sent Roland to the Conflux Mountain in the Chersonese to open himself to Mana. I'm honestly worried if he'll be able to handle the journey. I need you to meet him inside there and keep him safe until he can open up his magical potential.
Once you've finished helping Roland at the Conflux Mountain, report to Gabriella Sullivan. She will direct your efforts to counter this crisis. Do whatever she asks of you.
I knew my faith in you was well placed. I hope you continue to prove helpful to us.
I hope not, but I am backed into a corner. And he is desperate to pay off his Blood Price. I think this will push him to be useful to the Collective for the first time in his life.
Yes, we do, [PlayerName]. And you will keep quiet about our existence. We perform our duties far better if no one knows we exist.
I hope there is no barbed meaning behind those words. We do what we do for the good of everyone in the Collective. All of Aurai, even.
I know you're not the most resourceful person we have, but I am out of options. I have an offer for you.
Come back when you have Quest License 4.
It may be some time before the situation changes again. You’re free for now. Come back in a few days, and I will let you know if there is more you can do.
Then I'll just have to pray that Roland is enough... Please, reconsider.
